mapper.sql: u.*, v.license_plate AS vehicle_plate, COALESCE(app.nick_name, app.user_name) AS applicant_name, COALESCE(drv.nick_name, drv.user_name) AS driver_name, COALESCE(expense_summary.total_expense_amount, 0) AS total_expense_amount, CASE WHEN u.start_mileage IS NOT NULL AND u.end_mileage IS NOT NULL THEN u.end_mileage - u.start_mileage ELSE NULL END AS trip_distance

FROM sys_vehicle_usage u LEFT JOIN sys_vehicle v ON v.vehicle_id = u.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN sys_user app ON app.user_id = u.applicant_id AND app.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user drv ON drv.user_id = u.driver_id AND drv.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT usage_id, SUM(amount) AS total_expense_amount FROM sys_vehicle_expense GROUP BY usage_id ) expense_summary ON expense_summary.usage_id = u.usage_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE u.usage_id = #{usageId} AND u.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT
WHERE u.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '3' ORDER BY COALESCE(u.dispatch_time, u.actual_start_time, u.start_time) DESC, u.usage_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
WHERE u.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status IN ('0','1') AND u.start_time >= NOW() ORDER BY u.start_time ASC, u.usage_id ASC LIMIT 1
